g.text: A model is not a label: 94.85% of oyster proteins have an AlphaFold DB model; 19.41% have no function label.
Proteins: UniProt 2026_03 one-protein-per-gene sets. Dark: none of these labels the protein.
InterPro: the matches UniProt lists from InterPro 110.0
Swiss-Prot hit: MMseqs2 18.8cc5c against Swiss-Prot 2026_03, identity > 30%

g.text: lit: the protein has an AlphaFold DB model for that accession, an InterPro match, or a Swiss-Prot hit above 30% identity (a hit to its own entry counts)
